notes: vMLX 1.6.32 — long-context serving hardened end to end. Deep hybrid conversations that previously crashed the engine now get a clean refusal with a working recovery: restart the model and the conversation restores from the disk cache (proven live past 100k tokens). Byte-exact cache answers verified across RAM, RAM+SSD, and SSD-only tiers for the Qwen, Laguna, Gemma 4, Muse Glimmer, and Step-3.7 lines; Muse reasoning-strength levels and multi-tool-call turns proven; MTP settings and all server settings persist across restart, sleep/wake, and app relaunch. Fixes: native-MTP text models no longer wedge after the cold-prefill-split change; admission declines are proper 413s on every API door; oversized deep-conversation cache payloads are no longer permanently unwritable; clearer in-app errors for deep-conversation refusals and port conflicts.
